now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#2
now.text: Mack helps Fitz rebuild the Overkill Device into the weapon that lets Coulson take down Carl Creel. He wants Creel dead for his part in Isabelle Hartley's death.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The man Mack wants dead for Isabelle Hartley's death.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who helps build the weapon that takes Creel down.

proposed.text: Mack helps Fitz rebuild the Overkill Device into the weapon that lets Coulson take down Carl Creel.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The Absorbing Man, brought down with a weapon Mack helps build.

changes.evidence: In Heavy Is the Head (S2#2) Mack only helps Fitz modify the Overkill Device that Coulson uses on Creel. Mack's tie to Hartley (both Gonzales plants) is revealed in S2#14-15, and Mack says he 'initially wanted Creel dead for killing Isabelle Hartley' only in S5#21 (AoS521), so the motive in the text and on Mack's card comes from later titles.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#2
now.text: Talbot, a fan of Hunter's army record, offers him money and a proper burial for Isabelle Hartley to betray Coulson.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Mercenary whom Talbot tries to bribe into betraying Coulson.
now.on_b_card_about_a: General who tries to bribe Hunter into betraying Coulson.

proposed.text: Talbot, a fan of Hunter's army record, offers him money to betray Coulson. Hunter names his price: two million dollars and a proper burial for Isabelle Hartley.

changes.evidence: Heavy Is the Head (S2#2): Talbot says a senate ally will pay Hunter to give up Coulson; it is Hunter who asks for a proper burial for Hartley ('Hunter wants Hartley to have an honorable funeral... for a proper burial for Hartley and two million dollars, he will give him Coulson'). The burial is Hunter's demand, not Talbot's offer.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#3
now.text: HYDRA brainwashes Donnie, and he becomes the villain Blizzard.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Donnie's old idol. HYDRA brainwashes Donnie into Blizzard.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The cadet Fitz once saved, brainwashed by HYDRA into Blizzard.

proposed.text: Fitz helps Coulson's team understand Donnie when he resurfaces with freezing powers. He learns from Ward that HYDRA has brainwashed Donnie and warns the team.

changes.evidence: The current text says nothing between the two. In Making Friends and Influencing People (S2#3) Fitz, with Mack's help, tells Coulson that Gill has trouble making friends, then confronts Ward, learns Gill was brainwashed by Hydra, and has Mack radio Coulson ('Fitz is saying Gill was brainwashed by Hydra').

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#3
now.text: Sunil Bakshi is Jemma Simmons' superior while she spies inside HYDRA, and he never suspects she works for S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Jemma's HYDRA superior while she spies, who never suspects her.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An agent under Bakshi in HYDRA, secretly a S.H.I.E.L.D. spy.

proposed.text: Sunil Bakshi grills Jemma for hiding that she knew Donnie Gill, then takes her on the mission to bring Donnie in and feeds her lines to say. She keeps her cover by pretending to save him from Skye's shot.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Jemma's HYDRA superior while she spies. Questions her loyalty, but she fools him.

changes.evidence: Making Friends and Influencing People (S2#3): Bakshi 'accuses her of lying' and grills her about not reporting that she knew the subject of Project Blizzard, asking if she is loyal to Hydra; he later feeds her lines on the ship, and Skye fakes a shot at Bakshi so Simmons can pretend to save him. 'Never suspects' is false: he suspects her in this very episode (and hunts her as the mole in S2#5).

now.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Hunter trades bets and stories with.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#3
proposed.text: Lance Hunter bets Mack that Skye went to the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy, loses, and has to do inventory work for him.

changes.evidence: The bet between them is in Making Friends and Influencing People (S2#3): 'Hunter made a bet with Alphonso Mackenzie that Skye had attended S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy... was forced to do inventory work for Mackenzie' (Hunter page, ref AoS203; also the episode plot: 'Alphonso Mackenzie and Lance Hunter show up, Hunter questions Skye's credibility'). It is their first on-screen exchange, so the stage belongs on S2#3; S2#4 has no bet.
